 +91 9148808717 | # chetanmajjagi3@gmail.com | ï LinkedIn | § GitHub | Portfoilo
Competitive Programming Profiles: Codeforces (Max: 1601) • CodeChef (Max: 1829) • LeetCode (2228)
INTRODUCTION
Backend Developer diving deep into the oceans of distributed architectures and high-level system design. Passionate about
building performance-focused, distributed, reliable, scalable applications and building & optimizing cloud Infra.
TECHNICAL SKILLS
• Languages: C/C++ (9.5/10), Python (8.5/10), JavaScript (8/10), SQL (9/10), Go (9/10)
• Web & Full Stack: React.js, Tailwind CSS, Python & FastAPI, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis, WebSockets
• Tools, Infra & DevOps: AWS, GCP, Nginx, k6, Git, CI/CD Pipeline, Supabase, Pgbouncer, Docker Swarm, Terraform
• Core Concepts: Data Structures & Algorithms, CS Fundamentals, Concurrency & Multi-threading, System Design.
EDUCATION
International Institute of Information Technology, Naya Raipur Naya Raipur, India
Bachelor of Technology in Computer Science Engineering (CGPA: 8.56/10.00) 2023 – 2027 (Expected)
PROJECTS
Tradeforces: Distributed HFT Benchmarking System § Git repo with detail Readme May 2026–Jun 2026
• Engineered an 8-microservice evaluation platform, utilizing Kata Containers and AWS Firecracker to provision
hardware-isolated microVMs in 200–300ms with strict CPU pinning.
• Automated runtime image compilation via Google Cloud Build and dynamic K3s pod generation, enforcing strict pod affinity
to perfectly co-locate evaluation workloads.
• Developed a microsecond-precision Go Telemetry Gateway (7-goroutine pipeline) to dispatch raw FIX protocol orders over
TCP. Used complex state-mapping data structures to track single-trade lifecycles and calculate execution latency.
• Architected a high-throughput event pipeline leveraging Redpanda for strict order serialization and GCP Pub/Sub for
decentralized worker queues and dynamic backpressure management.
• Tech Stack: Go, FastAPI, React, GCS, Cloud Build, Redpanda, Pub/Sub, Postgres, Kubernetes (K3s), Docker, Terraform.
Ping: Distributed Real-Time Messaging System § Git repo with detail Readme Apr 2026-Present
• Engineered Ping, a real-time messaging system, by evolving a monolithic design into a scalable microservices architecture that
decouples the main API from the connection manager.
• Developed a co-locating FastAPI and gRPC servers in a single Python application to share memory for Websocket objects.
• Architected a Distributed system, enabling horizontal scaling with a Dynamic Nginx Load Balancer for the gateway and Redis
for the replica mapping and finding active replicas.
• In a high-concurrency k6 Load test with backend deployed as a multi-replica in a multi-instance setup, the system handled
8000 concurrent virtual users and P95 latency of 198ms on 6000 vus on a 5-core infra with Redis and Postgres GCP services.
• Tech Stack: Python, FastAPI, gRPC, Redis, ws, Postgres, k6, AWS, GCP, Nginx, CI/CD, PgBouncer, Docker Swarm, Terraform.
AI-Powered Relocation Survey Management System § Github Jan 2026-May 2026
• Digitalized the village relocation workflow, with the CV stage detection and a 4-step verification pipeline for transparency.
• Built an AI chatbot for real-time dynamic data analysis and visualization by plain-English queries, where the LLM generates
pseudo-queries routed through a validator layer to enforce role-based authorization and enhanced security.
• Tech Stack: React, Flutter, Python, Flask, MongoDB, OpenCV, AI/LLM Integration.
ACHIEVEMENTS & CODING PROfiLE
Competitive Programming
• Codeforces: Expert (1600+). 277, 956 ranks in contests.
• LeetCode: Guardian (2200+). Top 0.8% globally. Ranks: 311, 375, 569, 571 in contests.
• CodeChef: 4 star (1800+). Top 2% globally. Global ranks in contests: 137, 244.
Contest Performances
• ICPC 2025 Asia West Regionalist - Rank 100th/320 in Amritapuri region.
• Codefest IICPC Regionalist (2025): Ranked 203/17,000 in Round 1; 168/200 in Round 2.
• IIT Ropar COD-COM: Secured 11th place in the onsite final round.
